title: Graham Hancock ties Cydonia's monoliths to Earth's ancient civilizations

tellings.quote: Graham Hancock he states in the Mars my that there could be some connection between the symbolism of these eroded monoliths in a place like Sidonia and the ancient civilizations of Earth

plain: The worn-down monolith shapes seen in Cydonia, a region of Mars, may share symbolism with the ancient civilizations of Earth, according to the writer Graham Hancock in his book The Mars Mystery, from 1998. Michels brings it up from that book in an episode about whether Mars once had life.
